# Kashif passive web checks

<!-- Generated by tools/webdata/gen_docs.py from vulnscan/webscan/rules.py and vulnscan/webscan/remediation.py. Do not edit by hand: run `python tools/webdata/gen_docs.py`. -->

Every rule of the passive web scanner (184 rules), with its default severity and the range a finding may take, its default confidence, and its mappings to CWE, the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG v4.2 checklist ids), OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 and OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 ("—" means no matching requirement). The mappings are Kashif's analyst mapping. The last column names the remediation snippets, listed after the tables.

كل قواعد الفحص السلبي للمواقع، مع الخطورة الافتراضية ومداها، ودرجة الثقة، والربط بـ CWE وWSTG وASVS 4.0.3 وASVS 5.0.0، ومقتطفات الإصلاح لكل قاعدة.

- **Severity:** critical, high, medium, low or info. A range means the rule sets the severity from context.
- **Confidence:** `certain` = deterministic protocol fact; `firm` = probably real; `tentative` = may exist, high false-positive chance. `--web-sensitivity strict` reports certain only, `default` certain and firm, `paranoid` everything, including the rules marked *paranoid only*.
- **Stability:** rule ids never change meaning and are never reused (1.x contract).

## Remediation snippets

Reports show the platforms detected for the scanned site first (from the `Server` / `X-Powered-By` headers and the technology inventory) and the others collapsed, with `example.com` replaced by the scanned host. Every snippet passes Kashif's own header, CSP, HSTS and cookie checks.

تعرض التقارير المنصات المكتشفة في الموقع أولًا ثم بقية المنصات مطوية، مع استبدال example.com باسم المضيف المفحوص.

<a id="s-hsts"></a>

### S-HSTS · Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) · ترويسة Strict-Transport-Security ‏(HSTS)

Tell browsers to use HTTPS only for this host (and its subdomains) for two years.

**Caution:** includeSubDomains forces HTTPS on every subdomain: confirm they all serve HTTPS first. Add preload only after reading hstspreload.org, because removal from the preload list takes months.

**تنبيه:** يفرض includeSubDomains استخدام HTTPS على كل النطاقات الفرعية، فتأكد أولًا من أنها كلها تعمل عبر HTTPS. ولا تضف preload إلا بعد قراءة شروط hstspreload.org، لأن الحذف من قائمة الإدراج المسبق يستغرق أشهرًا.

**All platforms**

```text
Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains
```

**nginx**

```nginx
# nginx (server block on 443; "always" also covers error responses).
# Caution: add_header in a location{} replaces all server-level add_header lines; repeat them there.
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains" always;
```

**Apache httpd 2.4**

```apache
# Apache httpd (mod_headers), inside <VirtualHost *:443>
Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains"
```

**IIS 10 (web.config)**

```xml
<!-- IIS 10 1709+: applicationHost.config / site <hsts>, or web.config custom header -->
<system.webServer><httpProtocol><customHeaders>
  <add name="Strict-Transport-Security" value="max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains" />
</customHeaders></httpProtocol></system.webServer>
```

**Caddy 2**

```caddy
example.com {
	header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains"
}
```

**Express (helmet 7+)**

```js
// Express + helmet
app.use(helmet.strictTransportSecurity({ maxAge: 63072000, includeSubDomains: true }));
```

**Django**

```python
# Django settings.py
SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 63072000
SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS = True
SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True
```

**Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot**

```java
// Spring Security 6
http.headers(h -> h.httpStrictTransportSecurity(s -> s.includeSubDomains(true).maxAgeInSeconds(63072000)));
```

**ASP.NET Core 8+**

```csharp
// ASP.NET Core
builder.Services.AddHsts(o => { o.MaxAge = TimeSpan.FromDays(730); o.IncludeSubDomains = true; });
app.UseHsts();
```

**Cloudflare**

SSL/TLS → Edge Certificates → HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) → Enable, Max Age 12 months or more, Apply HSTS policy to subdomains. Add preload only after reading hstspreload.org (removal takes months).

Used by: `WEB-strict-transport-security`, `WEB110`, `WEB111`, `WEB112`, `WEB113`, `WEB114`, `WEB115`, `WEB116`, `WEB117`, `WEB318`

<a id="s-redir"></a>

### S-REDIR · Redirect HTTP to HTTPS (same host first, permanent) · توجيه HTTP إلى HTTPS (نفس المضيف أولًا، توجيه دائم)

Answer every plain-HTTP request with a 301/308 redirect to the same host on HTTPS; redirect to another host only after that.

**Caution:** Behind a proxy or load balancer that terminates TLS, check the forwarded protocol header (X-Forwarded-Proto) or the redirect will loop. For APIs, do not redirect: close port 80 or answer 403.

**تنبيه:** إذا كان TLS يُنهى عند وكيل أو موزّع أحمال فاعتمد على ترويسة البروتوكول المُمرَّرة (X-Forwarded-Proto) وإلا دار التوجيه في حلقة. أما واجهات API فلا توجّهها، بل أغلق المنفذ 80 أو أجب بـ 403.

**All platforms**

APIs (ASVS 5.0 4.1.2): do not redirect; close port 80 or return 403.

**nginx**

```nginx
server { listen 80; listen [::]:80; server_name example.com www.example.com; return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }
```

**Apache httpd 2.4**

```apache
<VirtualHost *:80>
    ServerName example.com
    ServerAlias example.com www.example.com
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]
</VirtualHost>
```

**IIS 10 (web.config)**

```xml
<!-- IIS: URL Rewrite module -->
<rewrite><rules><rule name="HTTPS" stopProcessing="true"><match url="(.*)" />
  <conditions><add input="{HTTPS}" pattern="off" /></conditions>
  <action type="Redirect" url="https://{HTTP_HOST}/{R:1}" redirectType="Permanent" />
</rule></rules></rewrite>
```

**Caddy 2**

Automatic: Caddy redirects HTTP to HTTPS by default for site addresses.

**Express (helmet 7+)**

```js
app.set("trust proxy", 1);
app.use((q, s, n) => q.secure ? n() : s.redirect(301, "https://" + q.headers.host + q.originalUrl));
```

Better: terminate TLS at the proxy and redirect there.

**Django**

```python
SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True
SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER = ("HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO", "https")   # only behind a proxy that sets it
```

**Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot**

```java
http.redirectToHttps(Customizer.withDefaults());   // Spring Security 6.5+
// older 6.x: http.requiresChannel(c -> c.anyRequest().requiresSecure());
```

**ASP.NET Core 8+**

```csharp
builder.Services.AddHttpsRedirection(o => o.RedirectStatusCode = 308);
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
```

**Cloudflare**

SSL/TLS → Edge Certificates → Always Use HTTPS = On.

Used by: `WEB000`, `WEB101`, `WEB102`, `WEB103`, `WEB104`, `WEB105`, `WEB118`, `WEB052`, `WEB504`

<a id="s-csp"></a>

### S-CSP · Content-Security-Policy (strict, nonce-based) · سياسة أمان المحتوى CSP (صارمة قائمة على nonce)

A strict CSP (nonce + 'strict-dynamic') for HTML pages and a locked-down CSP for APIs; the nonce is 16+ random bytes in base64, new for every response, also set as nonce="…" on every <script>.

**Caution:** A strict CSP blocks every script without the nonce, including inline event handlers (onclick=): deploy it as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only first and switch once the reports are clean.

**تنبيه:** تمنع سياسة CSP الصارمة كل سكربت لا يحمل الـ nonce، بما في ذلك معالجات الأحداث المضمّنة (onclick=)؛ فطبّقها أولًا بالترويسة Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only ثم انتقل إلى التطبيق الفعلي بعد خلو التقارير من المخالفات.

**All platforms**

```text
Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'nonce-{RANDOM}' 'strict-dynamic' https: 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; report-uri /csp-report; report-to csp
Reporting-Endpoints:     csp="https://example.com/csp-report"
API responses:          Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
```

'https:' and 'unsafe-inline' are ignored by CSP3 browsers when a nonce and 'strict-dynamic' are present; they only keep very old browsers working. Reporting-Endpoints defines the group that report-to names.

**nginx**

```nginx
# nginx: per-request nonce requires a module (ngx_http_sub/njs) — prefer setting CSP in the application.
# Static sites without inline scripts can use a hash/allowlist policy:
add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'" always;
```

**Apache httpd 2.4**

```apache
Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'"
# Per-request nonce: mod_unique_id + "Header set ... 'nonce-%{UNIQUE_ID}e'" is NOT random enough; generate the nonce in the app.
```

**IIS 10 (web.config)**

```xml
<add name="Content-Security-Policy" value="default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'" />
```

**Caddy 2**

```caddy
header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'"
```

**Express (helmet 7+)**

```js
// Express + helmet with a per-request nonce
const crypto = require("node:crypto");
app.use((req, res, next) => { res.locals.cspNonce = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("base64"); next(); });
app.use(helmet.contentSecurityPolicy({ directives: {
  "script-src": [(req, res) => `'nonce-${res.locals.cspNonce}'`, "'strict-dynamic'"],
  "object-src": ["'none'"], "base-uri": ["'none'"], "frame-ancestors": ["'none'"], "form-action": ["'self'"] } }));
// templates: <script nonce="<%= cspNonce %>">
```

**Django**

```python
# Django >= 6.0 (built-in): MIDDLEWARE += ["django.middleware.csp.ContentSecurityPolicyMiddleware"]
from django.utils.csp import CSP
SECURE_CSP = {"script-src": [CSP.NONCE, CSP.STRICT_DYNAMIC], "object-src": [CSP.NONE],
              "base-uri": [CSP.NONE], "frame-ancestors": [CSP.NONE], "form-action": [CSP.SELF]}
# add "django.template.context_processors.csp" to TEMPLATES context_processors; templates: <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}">
# Django < 6.0: the django-csp package
```

**Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot**

```java
// Spring Security 6 (nonce: generate per request in a filter and expose it to templates)
http.headers(h -> h.contentSecurityPolicy(c -> c.policyDirectives(
    "script-src 'nonce-{nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'")));
```

**ASP.NET Core 8+**

```csharp
// ASP.NET Core middleware
app.Use(async (ctx, next) => {
    var nonce = Convert.ToBase64String(System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16));
    ctx.Items["csp-nonce"] = nonce;
    ctx.Response.Headers.ContentSecurityPolicy = $"script-src 'nonce-{nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'";
    await next(); });
```

**Cloudflare**

```js
const r = new Response(res.body, res); r.headers.set("Content-Security-Policy", policy); return r;
```

Rules → Transform Rules → Modify Response Header → Set static Content-Security-Policy (static policies only). For a nonce use a Worker (code above) and HTMLRewriter to add nonce attributes.

Used by: `WEB-content-security-policy`, `WEB040`, `WEB041`, `WEB042`, `WEB043`, `WEB200`, `WEB201`, `WEB202`, `WEB203`, `WEB204`, `WEB205`, `WEB207`, `WEB208`, `WEB209`, `WEB210`, `WEB211`, `WEB212`, `WEB213`, `WEB214`, `WEB215`, `WEB216`, `WEB217`, `WEB218`, `WEB219`, `WEB318`, `WEB515`

<a id="s-frame"></a>

### S-FRAME · Clickjacking protection (frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options) · الحماية من Clickjacking ‏(frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options)

Forbid other sites from framing your pages: CSP frame-ancestors for current browsers, X-Frame-Options for old ones.

**Caution:** 'none' / DENY also stops your own site from framing the page; use 'self' / SAMEORIGIN if you embed your own pages.

**تنبيه:** تمنع القيمة 'none' أو DENY موقعك أنت أيضًا من تضمين الصفحة؛ فاستخدم 'self' أو SAMEORIGIN إن كنت تضمّن صفحاتك.

**All platforms**

```text
Content-Security-Policy: <your policy>; frame-ancestors 'none'      (or 'self')
X-Frame-Options: DENY                                                (or SAMEORIGIN; for old browsers)
```

Add frame-ancestors to the policy you already send (S-CSP): a policy with only frame-ancestors restricts no scripts, and Kashif reports it as such (WEB042).

**nginx**

```nginx
add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
```

**Apache httpd 2.4**

```apache
Header always set X-Frame-Options "DENY"
```

**IIS 10 (web.config)**

```xml
<add name="X-Frame-Options" value="DENY" />
```

Inside <system.webServer><httpProtocol><customHeaders> of web.config.

**Caddy 2**

```caddy
header X-Frame-Options "DENY"
```

**Express (helmet 7+)**

```js
app.use(helmet.xFrameOptions({ action: "deny" }));
```

**Django**

```python
X_FRAME_OPTIONS = "DENY"
```

The default since Django 3.0 (XFrameOptionsMiddleware).

**Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot**

```java
http.headers(h -> h.frameOptions(f -> f.deny()));
```

The default in Spring Security.

**ASP.NET Core 8+**

```csharp
app.Use(async (ctx, next) => {
    ctx.Response.Headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY";
    await next(); });
```

**Cloudflare**

Rules → Transform Rules → Modify Response Header → Set static: X-Frame-Options = DENY

<a id="s-iso"></a>

### S-ISO · Cross-origin isolation (COOP, CORP, COEP) · العزل بين المصادر (COOP وCORP وCOEP)

Keep other sites' windows and pages away from yours: COOP same-origin, CORP same-origin, and COEP only if you need crossOriginIsolated.

**Caution:** COOP same-origin breaks OAuth and payment pop-ups (use same-origin-allow-popups there); COEP require-corp blocks cross-origin resources that send no CORP/CORS headers, so test it first.

**تنبيه:** تُعطّل COOP بالقيمة same-origin النوافذ المنبثقة لتسجيل الدخول OAuth والدفع (فاستخدم same-origin-allow-popups هناك)، وتمنع COEP بالقيمة require-corp الموارد الخارجية التي لا ترسل ترويسات CORP أو CORS، فجرّبها أولًا.

**All platforms**

```text
Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin                 (same-origin-allow-popups if OAuth / payment popups are used)
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin               (same-site for assets shared with sibling subdomains)
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp              (only if you need crossOriginIsolated; test first)
```

**nginx**

```nginx
add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin" always;
```

```apache

```


Inside <system.webServer><httpProtocol><customHeaders> of web.config.

```caddy

```

<a id="s-cookie"></a>

### S-COOKIE · Session cookie attributes · سمات كوكي الجلسة

Set session cookies with the __Host- prefix, Path=/, Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax.

**Caution:** Renaming the session cookie (__Host-) logs every user out once, and SameSite=Strict would also drop the session on links from other sites; Lax is the safe default.

**تنبيه:** تغيير اسم كوكي الجلسة (إلى __Host-) يُخرج كل المستخدمين مرة واحدة، والقيمة SameSite=Strict تُسقط الجلسة أيضًا عند القدوم من روابط مواقع أخرى؛ لذا فالقيمة Lax هي الخيار الآمن الافتراضي.

**All platforms**

```text
Set-Cookie: __Host-sid=<random>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax
Cache-Control: no-store
```

A response that sets a session cookie must not be stored by shared caches: send Cache-Control: no-store on it (S-CACHE).

**nginx**

```nginx
proxy_cookie_flags ~ secure httponly samesite=lax;
```

nginx 1.19.3+ as a reverse proxy; prefer fixing the application.

**Apache httpd 2.4**

```apache
Header always edit Set-Cookie "^((?!.*;\s*Secure).*)$" "$1; Secure"
```

Proxy, last resort; prefer the application setting.

**IIS 10 (web.config)**

```xml
<system.web><httpCookies requireSSL="true" httpOnlyCookies="true" sameSite="Lax" /></system.web>
```

IIS / ASP.NET web.config.

**Express (helmet 7+)**

```js
session({ name: "__Host-sid", cookie: { secure: true, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "lax", path: "/" } })
```

**Django**

```python
SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True
SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY = True   # default
SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE = "Lax"   # default
SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = "__Host-sessionid"
CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True
```

**Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot**

```properties
server.servlet.session.cookie.secure=true
server.servlet.session.cookie.http-only=true
server.servlet.session.cookie.same-site=lax
# stops ;jsessionid= URLs
server.servlet.session.tracking-modes=cookie
```

Spring Boot application.properties.

**ASP.NET Core 8+**

```csharp
builder.Services.ConfigureApplicationCookie(o => { o.Cookie.Name = "__Host-auth"; o.Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.Always; o.Cookie.HttpOnly = true; o.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax; o.Cookie.Path = "/"; });
```

**Cloudflare**

Cookies are set by the origin; fix them there (a Worker can rewrite Set-Cookie as a stop-gap).

**PHP**

```ini
session.cookie_secure=1
session.cookie_httponly=1
session.cookie_samesite=Lax
session.use_only_cookies=1
session.use_trans_sid=0
```

**F5 BIG-IP**

WEB411: enable "Cookie Encryption" in the persistence profile.

<a id="s-cors"></a>

### S-CORS · CORS: allowlist, never reflect · CORS: قائمة سماح محددة وعدم عكس الأصل أبدًا

Answer cross-origin requests only for the origins you trust, add Vary: Origin, and delete Flash/Silverlight policy files.

**Caution:** Removing a reflected or wildcard origin breaks any partner site that relied on it: list those origins explicitly before switching.

**تنبيه:** حذف الأصل المعكوس أو الشامل (*) يعطّل أي موقع شريك كان يعتمد عليه، فأدرج تلك المصادر صراحةً قبل التغيير.



django-cors-headers; never CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINS with credentials.


Never a * pattern with setAllowCredentials(true).

**ASP.NET Core 8+**

<a id="s-dotfiles"></a>

### S-DOTFILES · Block VCS folders, backups, env/config files and source maps · منع الوصول إلى مجلدات التحكم بالإصدارات والنسخ الاحتياطية وملفات الإعداد وخرائط المصدر

Deny hidden files and folders (except /.well-known/), backups, dumps, env files and source maps at the web server, and deploy build artifacts only.

**Caution:** Keep /.well-known/ reachable (ACME certificate renewal and security.txt need it), and check that no needed file uses a blocked extension.


<a id="s-tls"></a>

### S-TLS · TLS configuration (Mozilla intermediate 6.0) · إعدادات TLS ‏(Mozilla intermediate 6.0)

TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only with forward-secret AEAD suites, a trusted certificate with automatic renewal, and the full chain.

**Caution:** Disabling TLS 1.0/1.1 cuts off very old clients (Android 4.3 and older, old embedded devices); check your traffic first.

**تنبيه:** تعطيل TLS 1.0 و1.1 يقطع العملاء القدامى جدًا (Android 4.3 وما قبله والأجهزة المدمجة القديمة)، فراجع حركة موقعك أولًا.

**All platforms**

Certificates: ACME (Let's Encrypt or another CA) with automatic renewal; RSA 2048 or ECDSA P-256; serve the full chain (fullchain.pem).

**nginx**

```nginx
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
ssl_ecdh_curve X25519MLKEM768:X25519:prime256v1:secp384r1;   # X25519MLKEM768 needs OpenSSL >= 3.5; drop it on older builds
ssl_session_tickets off;
ssl_stapling on; ssl_stapling_verify on;                     # only if the certificate has an OCSP URL
```

**Apache httpd 2.4**

```apache
SSLProtocol             -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3
SSLCipherSuite          ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305
SSLHonorCipherOrder     off
SSLSessionTickets       off
SSLCompression          off
```

**IIS 10 (web.config)**

Windows: disable SSL 2.0/3.0 and TLS 1.0/1.1 under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols (Enabled=0 for Server), order suites with Disable-TlsCipherSuite or Group Policy, then reboot.

**Caddy 2**

```caddy
tls {
	protocols tls1.2 tls1.3
}
```

Defaults are already TLS 1.2+ with modern suites; this only pins them.

**Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot**

```properties
server.ssl.enabled-protocols=TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3
```

**Cloudflare**

SSL/TLS → Edge Certificates → Minimum TLS Version = 1.2, TLS 1.3 = On; SSL mode "Full (strict)".

**Node.js**

```js
minVersion: "TLSv1.2"
```

If Node terminates TLS (tls/https options).

<a id="s-mixed"></a>

### S-MIXED · Remove mixed content · إزالة المحتوى المختلط

Change http:// subresource and form URLs to https:// (or a relative URL on your own origin), and add upgrade-insecure-requests as a safety net.

**Caution:** upgrade-insecure-requests makes the browser fetch https:// instead; a host without HTTPS then fails to load, so check every third-party URL.

**تنبيه:** يجعل upgrade-insecure-requests المتصفح يطلب https://‎ بدلًا من ذلك، فيفشل تحميل أي مضيف لا يدعم HTTPS، لذا تحقّق من كل رابط خارجي.

**All platforms**

```text
Content-Security-Policy: <your policy>; upgrade-insecure-requests
```

Add the directive to the policy you already send (S-CSP). Sent alone it restricts no scripts.

Used by: `WEB050`, `WEB051`, `WEB502`

<a id="s-sri"></a>

### S-SRI · Subresource Integrity for third-party code · التحقق من سلامة الموارد الخارجية (SRI)

Load third-party scripts and stylesheets from a pinned, versioned URL with an integrity hash and crossorigin="anonymous"; restrict evergreen vendor scripts with CSP instead, or self-host them.

**Caution:** The browser blocks the file when its content changes, so pin a versioned URL; evergreen scripts (Google Tag Manager, Stripe.js) cannot use SRI.

**تنبيه:** يمنع المتصفح الملف إذا تغيّر محتواه، لذا ثبّت رابطًا بإصدار محدد؛ أما السكربتات المتغيرة باستمرار (Google Tag Manager وStripe.js) فلا يمكن استخدام SRI معها.

**All platforms**

```html
<script src="https://cdn.example.net/lib/1.2.3/lib.min.js" integrity="sha384-<base64>" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
```

**All platforms**

```shell
openssl dgst -sha384 -binary lib.min.js | openssl base64 -A
```

Compute the integrity value of the exact file you load.

Used by: `WEB053`, `WEB500`, `WEB501`, `WEB503`, `WEB506`, `WEB517`, `WEB519`

<a id="s-libs"></a>

### S-LIBS · Upgrade vulnerable components · تحديث المكونات المصابة بثغرات

Upgrade the library or platform to the fixed version, rebuild and redeploy; add Kashif's dependency scan (kashif <project-dir>) or npm audit to CI.

**Caution:** A major-version upgrade can change APIs: run your tests and read the library's migration notes before deploying.

**تنبيه:** قد يغيّر التحديث إلى إصدار رئيسي جديد واجهات البرمجة، فشغّل اختباراتك واقرأ ملاحظات الترحيل قبل النشر.

**All platforms**

```shell
npm install <lib>@<fixed>
```

Or replace the CDN URL with the fixed version.

**All platforms**

```shell
kashif <project-dir>
```

Run in CI so the next vulnerable version is caught before deployment.

Used by: `WEB054`, `WEB080`, `WEB081`, `WEB803`

<a id="s-sectxt"></a>

### S-SECTXT · security.txt (RFC 9116) · ملف security.txt ‏(RFC 9116)

Publish /.well-known/security.txt as text/plain; charset=utf-8 so researchers know how to report a vulnerability.

**Caution:** Expires must be renewed before it passes (less than a year ahead is recommended); an expired file is treated as invalid.

**تنبيه:** يجب تجديد قيمة Expires قبل حلول موعدها (يُنصح بأن تكون بعد أقل من سنة)، فالملف المنتهي يُعدّ غير صالح.

**All platforms**

```text
Contact: mailto:security@example.com
Expires: <scan date + 6 months, e.g. 2027-05-13T00:00:00.000Z>
Preferred-Languages: ar, en
Canonical: https://example.com/.well-known/security.txt
Policy: https://example.com/security-policy
```

Expires is the scan date + 6 months (RFC 9116 §2.5.5 recommends less than a year).

Used by: `WEB060`, `WEB900`

<a id="s-cache"></a>

### S-CACHE · Do not cache sensitive responses · منع تخزين الاستجابات الحساسة مؤقتًا

Send Cache-Control: no-store on personalised and authenticated responses, never public/s-maxage, and clear the browser's data on logout.

**Caution:** Apply no-store only to sensitive paths: on static assets it slows the site down. Clear-Site-Data "cookies" logs the user out of every subdomain, so send it on the logout response only.

**تنبيه:** طبّق no-store على المسارات الحساسة فقط، لأنها تُبطئ الموقع إن طُبّقت على الملفات الثابتة. وتُخرج القيمة Clear-Site-Data "cookies" المستخدم من كل النطاقات الفرعية، فأرسلها في استجابة تسجيل الخروج فقط.

**All platforms**

```text

Clear-Site-Data: "cache", "cookies", "storage"      (logout response only)
```

<a id="s-breach"></a>

### S-BREACH · BREACH: protect secrets in compressed responses · BREACH: حماية الأسرار في الاستجابات المضغوطة

Keep compression; mask CSRF tokens per response (Django, Rails and Laravel already do), avoid reflecting user input next to secrets, or disable compression on those pages only.

**Caution:** Turning compression off site-wide makes pages slower and is not needed; limit it to pages that mix secrets with user input.

**تنبيه:** تعطيل الضغط في الموقع كله يبطئ الصفحات ولا حاجة إليه؛ فاقصره على الصفحات التي تخلط الأسرار بمدخلات المستخدم.

Used by: `WEB119`

<a id="s-html"></a>

### S-HTML · Fix the page markup or script · إصلاح كود الصفحة أو السكربت

Change the markup or script named in the evidence: add rel="noopener" to target=_blank links, send forms with POST to your own HTTPS origin, keep secrets out of URLs and treat location/postMessage data as untrusted.

**Caution:** Test the page after the change: forms, sign-in and links to partner sites can depend on the old behaviour.

**تنبيه:** اختبر الصفحة بعد التعديل، فالنماذج وتسجيل الدخول والروابط إلى المواقع الشريكة قد تعتمد على السلوك القديم.

**All platforms**

```html
<a href="https://partner.example.net/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">…</a>
```

Used by: `WEB505`, `WEB508`, `WEB509`, `WEB511`, `WEB512`, `WEB513`, `WEB514`, `WEB518`, `WEB520`, `WEB521`, `WEB522`, `WEB614`, `WEB619`, `WEB802`

<a id="s-secret"></a>

### S-SECRET · Revoke and rotate the exposed secret · إبطال السرّ المكشوف واستبداله

Revoke the secret at its provider and issue a new one first, then move it server-side so it never reaches the browser again, and check the provider's logs for misuse.

**Caution:** Removing the secret from the page is not enough: it is already public and cached, so it must be revoked.

**تنبيه:** حذف السرّ من الصفحة لا يكفي، فقد صار علنيًا ومخزّنًا في ذاكرات مؤقتة، ولا بد من إبطاله.

**All platforms**

Use the provider's key-management page to revoke the key; for payment card data, follow your PCI DSS incident process.

Used by: `WEB609`, `WEB610`, `WEB612`, `WEB613`

<a id="s-admin"></a>

### S-ADMIN · Restrict admin and login pages · تقييد صفحات الإدارة والدخول

Allow admin paths only from your network or VPN, or protect them with strong authentication, MFA and rate limiting.

**Caution:** Make sure you keep a way in (a VPN or an allowed address) before restricting the admin path, or you lock yourself out.

**تنبيه:** تأكد من بقاء طريق للوصول (VPN أو عنوان مسموح) قبل تقييد مسار الإدارة، حتى لا تُغلق الباب على نفسك.

**nginx**

```nginx
location /admin/ { allow 203.0.113.0/24; deny all; }
```

**Apache httpd 2.4**

```apache
<Location "/admin/">
    Require ip 203.0.113.0/24
</Location>
```

Used by: `WEB083`

<a id="s-takeover"></a>

### S-TAKEOVER · Remove the dangling DNS record · حذف سجل DNS المعلّق

Delete the CNAME (or other record) that points to the unclaimed provider resource, or claim the resource again at the provider, today.

**Caution:** Check the subdomain's content and cookies after reclaiming it: someone may already have served pages from it.

**تنبيه:** افحص محتوى النطاق الفرعي وكوكيزه بعد استعادته، فربما قدّم أحدهم صفحات منه بالفعل.

**All platforms**

Remove the record at your DNS provider, then confirm with your provider's DNS lookup tool.

Used by: `WEB901`

<a id="s-incident"></a>

### S-INCIDENT · Incident response · الاستجابة للحادث

Treat the site as compromised: take a copy of the evidence, remove the injected code, find how it got in, patch it, rotate credentials and check other pages.

**Caution:** Restoring a backup without closing the entry point lets the attacker return; patch first.

**تنبيه:** استعادة نسخة احتياطية دون سد نقطة الدخول تسمح للمهاجم بالعودة، فأصلح الثغرة أولًا.

**All platforms**

Notify affected users and the authorities your law requires.

Used by: `WEB507`
